So, yesterday a few friends and myself started the adventure path Legacy of Fire. I'm playing as a feral orc true primitive. I can only speak in grunts and gestures. So we are following this caravan around and suddenly we see a camp ahead of us... and it's on fire.

So the party cleric goes and creates a bunch of water to put it out, and I help push a wagon back onto its wheels. Everything is going good, and then we're asked to go and find out who set the place on fire. We go and talk to just about everyone, when we finally get to the last guy. We talk to him, and by that I mean the rest of the party talks to him while I grunt toward him. We ask him if he knows whats up, WHEN SUDDENLY, he gets all defensive. We interrogate him for a bit, and then he gets super pissy pants, so I grapple him and give him a big old orcish hug, letting the guards take him away.

We go outside and find out a camel ran off. I go up to the tracks and roll a nat 20, allowing me to make the check to follow. None of the other party members follow me since I can't tell them shit besides grunts and gestures. I end up getting into a cacti forest, and fighting 5 little creatures called pugwami's I believe, and I take them, although I nearly died.

I saved the camel and rode it back home to the camp, thus ending the first session.
Story time: Talk about your game 1

I am running a large (8-person) salt box based around pirating around the Shackles. As a fun way to get players into the game one of the stipulation was that as part of your backstory you had to explain how in the past week or so your character ended up pissing off a massive Ulfen barbarian pirate named "Lucky" Lars.

Then as players were chilling in the bar during the opening meet & greet, a massive bar fight erupts (using my custom super secret bar fight rules for maximum fun!) in the middle of the fight a ship's deed and piles of coins are thrown into the mix causing the players to scramble for ownership of a boat or stuffing their pockets with gold (or just plain punching people in the face, it is a bar fight). And of course who should appear in the middle of it? That's right, everyone's favorite Barbarian, Lucky Lars. Given that when raging and power attacking he had a +10 damage modifier to his punches he could knock out almost any player with a single punch and thus the players entered into a deadly dance where they tried to keep other bar brawlers between them and Lars while also trying to grab that elusive ship deed.

Had a few hiccups but overall went great!
